## What changes for the learner? / 学习者会感受到什么变化？

<!-- State the problem and resulting behavior. Include a concrete card, question, or screen when relevant.
说明问题与修改后的行为，必要时写明卡牌、题目或页面。 -->

## Validation / 验证

<!-- List commands actually run and their results. State what remains unverified.
只列实际运行的命令与结果，说明尚未验证的部分。 -->

## Screenshots or content example / 截图或内容示例

<!-- For visible or lesson changes, show the relevant before/after using synthetic data.
界面或课程改动提供相关前后对照，使用虚构数据。 -->

## Review notes / 评审说明

- [ ] Both languages preserve the same behavior and teaching meaning, or this change does not affect language. / 两种语言的行为与教学含义一致，或本次不涉及语言。
- [ ] Stable IDs, stored progress, and old backups remain compatible, or a tested migration is included. / 保持 ID、进度和旧备份兼容，或附带已验证迁移。
- [ ] Relevant tests are preserved; failures and checks not run are disclosed. / 保留相关测试，说明失败和未运行的检查。
- [ ] New material has appropriate rights and attribution; no private reading records or credentials are included. / 新内容的权利与署名合适，不包含私人抽牌记录或凭据。

<!-- Link a related issue if one exists. For small corrections, an issue is not required.
有关联 issue 时附链接；小修正不强制先建 issue。 -->
